slice: P2 AC1027 consumed-style MLINE 2-to-1 removal with cap-suppression flags
scope: Permit a selected AC1027 direct consumed-style removal from two MLINESTYLE elements to one when source MLINE group-71 flags are 5, 9 or 13. Preserve the open/cap-suppression flags while retaining the selected source element and projecting its group-41 parameters.

specEvidence.group41: Element parameters describe per-element segment intersections, starts and cuts. Cap suppression is carried separately in group 71.
specEvidence.interpretation: The selected removal selects one ordered survivor and recalculates its per-vertex group-41 parameters while preserving the documented cap state. Native cap rendering is not independently verified.

contract.admission: AC1027 only, direct edit of a source-bound consumed style from exactly two elements to one. Either ordered survivor is admitted. MLINE group-71 values 1, 5, 9 and 13 are admitted for this packet; 5/9/13 suppress start/end/both caps. Closed value 3 and unknown-bit value 17 refuse. The MLINESTYLE flags remain 2.
contract.projection: The two source offsets are [1.25,-0.75]. The selected output retains either element at its original position, changes the style element count to one, preserves both consumers' vertex geometry and group-71 flags, and emits one group-74 segment with two group-41 values and group-75 zero per vertex. Bottom justification rebases parameters against the retained offset. Group 340 remains bound to the edited source style.
contract.outputAndReadback: Twenty-four positive combinations cover both survivor positions, flags 5/9/13, and ASCII/binary input/output. Physical output checks the surviving style tuple, group 71, group 340, group 73, group 74, group 75, exact group-41 parameters and both ENTITIES/BLOCKS consumers. Fresh typed readback checks survivor identity, flags, style reference, vertices, miters and parameters.
contract.failureAndRetry: Closed and unknown group-71 profiles each refuse for both output encodings while preserving a destination sentinel and caller state; corrected flags-13 sources then succeed through the same writer. A late consumer-parameter mutation refuses atomically for both output encodings and succeeds on the same adapter after restoring caller state.
contract.compatibility: The new nondefault-cap admission is restricted to the AC1027 direct consumed-style 2-to-1 removal. Other removal counts, direct offset edits, append counts, retarget routes, other versions and native cap appearance remain outside this receipt. No drawing fixture was committed; all sources are generated in temporary directories.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: The extended recipe in tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp generates the selected MLINESTYLE and MLINE source records at runtime; output proof inspects physical records and freshly imports the serialized output.

focusedSelectors.summary: 3/3 passed in 1.40s. The new removal selector covers 24 positive survivor/encoding profiles, 4 closed/unknown refusals with corrected-source retry, and 2 late-mutation refusals with same-adapter retry; ordinary removal and cap-flag append selectors also pass.

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; this slice adds no new allocation, ownership, lifetime, bounds or handle path.

limitations: Only AC1027 direct consumed-style removal from two elements to one is covered.
Group-71 flags are preserved and read back, but native cap appearance and rendered geometry are not qualified.
Other removal counts, direct edits, append counts, retarget routes, versions, document closure and support claims remain outside this receipt.
